question: On 30th September 2024, Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the jury had selected veteran film actor _______ as the recipient of the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award for 2022.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mithun Chakraborty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mithun Chakraborty**, a veteran Indian film actor, has been chosen as the recipient of the **Dadasaheb Phalke Lifetime Achievement Award** for the year **2022**. This was announced on **30th September 2024** by Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting, **Ashwini Vaishnaw**.
 
• The **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** is the highest honor in Indian cinema, instituted by the Government of India in **1969** to commemorate **Dadasaheb Phalke**, the father of Indian cinema.
 
• Mithun Chakra
